name: Feyward Dan — Level 3 One-Armed Paladin Player Character

details.appearance: A one-armed Toad with a colorful Feywild aura, a scar from the Estragon Island escape, and a third multi-dimensional sensory eye. The missing arm is permanent in the current record; no prosthetic is assumed.
details.trait: I apologize to the room first. Then I test the window—with the arm I have.
details.ideal: Continuity and protection. The planes may disagree about which Dan I am, but I decide who I protect.
details.bond: The party that keeps finding me across mazes, estates, and collapsing realities, and the people who cannot survive without a shield in the doorway.
details.flaw: I trust the nearest exit more than the person explaining why it is locked, and I hate being treated as fragile.
details.eyes: Two ordinary eyes and one Feyward sensory eye
details.faith: Unresolved; has encountered forces that call themselves gods
details.skin: Toad green with Feywild color shift

languages.custom: Can recognize Feyward planar terminology; speaks under pressure with uncertain confidence.

armorProf.custom: Light, medium, and heavy armor; shields. Dan fights one-handed and does not receive a second-weapon benefit.

weaponProf.custom: Simple and martial weapons; longsword; one-handed use only.

biography.value:
Feyward Dan — Player Character Dossier

Level 3 One-Armed Feyward Paladin / Dimensional Escapee. This is the parallel Feyward Dan, not the original Dan who led the Liberated Toads and lost his arm to the corrupted mage staff. Feyward Dan woke in a yellow bed at Prismari's school, survived goblin betrayal, escaped through a window, was dragged through the Mazebound, slept through multiple dimensional emergencies, and opened his third sensory eye during the Imp Ambush.

Ledger: 1,960 XP, 11 entries, Level 3, Power 5 Mortal. The actor is a playable translation of the lore; the XP ledger remains authoritative.

Confirmed carried inventory: one sword of uncertain provenance, chain mail, Shield +1, Holy Symbol of Ravenkind, and ten gold pieces. The sword is the blade Dan used when he charged Professor Prismari after the explosion on Estragon's Island. The school journal, Prismari, Mazebound, and other events remain in the biography and source records rather than being invented as carried loot.

Inventory rule: this actor deliberately contains only gear and abilities Dan actually has or was explicitly assigned. Memories, event records, and things he merely saw are not added to the inventory as fake loot.

How to play Feyward Dan

Use charm, improvisation, and sensory magic before force. Dan is not a polished wizard. He is a displaced player character who survives by testing doors, apologizing, fleeing when necessary, and returning when the party needs his eye.

One-armed paladin rules

Dan uses a longsword in his remaining hand and a shield in the other available hand. He cannot dual-wield or make two-handed weapon attacks. Divine Sense, Divine Smite, and the Aura of Life campaign item are included as documents. Aura of Life is recorded as a story/boon item and should be level-gated by the GM if standard 5e progression is being enforced.
biography.public: Feyward Dan is a parallel Toad with a colorful Feywild aura, an unreliable itinerary, and one extra eye that sees what invisible enemies hoped would remain unseen.

description.value: Level 3 one-armed paladin interpretation of Feyward Dan. The oath is not finalized; the sheet preserves his parallel identity, Feywild aura, protective instinct, and divine encounters.
Medium Toad. The Feyward variant is a parallel-reality survivor. No ancestry memories are assumed to be shared with Original Dan.
Dan survived Prismari's school, a goblin ambush, the Mazebound, and multiple plane fractures. Suggested proficiencies: Insight, Persuasion, Survival, and Sylvan.

Once per short rest, open the third eye for 1 minute. You can perceive invisible creatures and identify the approximate seam of a nearby portal or planar disguise. The eye is noticeable and may attract attention.

When Dan casts a spell or crosses a planar boundary, the GM may introduce a harmless or dangerous Feyward complication: color inversion, a misplaced door, involuntary apology, or a brief duplicate shadow.

Dan is proficient with windows, thornbushes, locked rooms, and routes that were not designed as exits. Once per short rest, gain advantage on one check made to escape a confined or unfamiliar location.
Dan can recognize that his memories do not line up with another Dan. He has advantage on checks to notice identity substitution, but disadvantage when asked to prove which history is original.
A colorful aura surrounds Dan. It is visible to trained Fey creatures and may identify him as a dimensional contaminant, visitor, or valuable specimen.
Dan may reroll one failed attack or escape check per long rest, but the reroll must be described as a second attempt, not effortless competence.
Dan knows the maze took him once. He has advantage on one check per journey to notice when a route is looping, singing, or trying to remove him from the party.
A blessed longsword used one-handed by Feyward Dan. The remaining arm grips it while the other hand is occupied by the shield. The versatile two-handed mode is not available to this character.
Interlocking chain mail with quilted underlayer and gauntlets. Heavy armor, AC 16, Strength requirement 13, stealth disadvantage.
A shield carried in Dan's available hand. Base shield +2 AC plus a +1 magical bonus. Dan cannot hold a second weapon while this is equipped.
A holy symbol of Ravenkind carried as Dan's divine focus. The campaign record establishes the relic; the GM decides whether its full artifact powers are active.

As a paladin feature, Dan can sense the presence of strong celestial, fiendish, or undead forces within the normal range and duration. Uses are tracked in the primary resource. Feyward distortions may make the result incomplete rather than false.

When Dan hits with the longsword, he may expend a spell slot to deal radiant damage. This feature is intentionally represented as a feat/item so the player can trigger it from the sheet; configure the exact activity in the GM's preferred automation module.

Feyward Dan is one-armed. The missing arm is canon, not a missing JSON field. He cannot use two-handed weapons, dual-wield, reload equipment that requires two hands without assistance, or carry a shield and a second held object simultaneously. The GM may apply disadvantage or alternate checks where a second hand is essential; do not apply a blanket penalty to every roll.

You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the attack roll or saving throw. Concentration, up to 1 minute.
You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn, if it can.
A creature you touch regains hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
Your prayer empowers your weapon attacks. Until the spell ends, your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage on a hit. Concentration, up to 1 minute.

A willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery. The target is immune to being frightened and gains temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each turn. Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead. Concentration, up to 10 minutes.

description.value: A shimmering field appears around a creature of your choice within range, granting a +2 bonus to AC for the duration. Concentration, up to 10 minutes.
